thread:
maria: quick intake — GH advisory flagged CVE-2026-0831 in SQLAlchemy (1.5.x / 2.0.x). appears to involve eval() use in MutableCompositeType when user-controlled types are deserialized. link: https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/security/advisories/0000

aj: saw it too from SCA + fuzz. quick triage: CVSS 8.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)

devsec-bot: EPSS: 0.67 (2026-03-19) — exploit PoC reported 2026-03-18. CVE published to NVD.

samuel: affected services: ingestion-worker, infra-store, analytics-api. ingestion-worker pulls sqlalchemy via our internal module pipeline-orm.

jing: flag: this could lead to RCE and exfil if process can access KMS-wrapped keys or local creds. check RBAC for the service account. :eyes:

maria: agreed. KMS keys are scoped, but need to validate if ingestion-worker has any decrypted key material in memory or mounted creds.

aj: proposed immediate actions: 1) pin to patched release (1.5.26 or 2.0.18), 2) run SBOM and targeted upgrade in canary images, 3) smoke tests and secrets-scan. who owns ingestion-worker? @samuel

samuel: taking ingestion-worker. I'll open a PR for pin + matrix test. ETA ~2h.

maria: analytics-api owner @jing — can you pick that up? add a small canary rollout and watch traces for latency impact.

jing: on it. also will audit KMS access logs and service account IAM roles; if we see key access tied to suspicious activity we escalate.

security-oncall: suggest adding this to incident board as HIGH. coordinate maintenance window if we must restart many pods. keep customer comms draft ready.

aj: rollout plan (suggested): branch -> upgrade -> run staging e2e -> canary 5% prod 30m -> 25% 1h -> full. fallback: image rollback. also include DB migration smoke checks.

maria: add CVE tag to repos and update SBOM. create tracker ticket and link PRs.

devsec-bot: created ticket INFSEC-5123 and assigned to samuel, jing. link: https://tracker.internal/INFSEC-5123

samuel: PR: https://github.com/redwood/ingestion-worker/pull/1456 — pins sqlalchemy, adds unit to cover MutableCompositeType, and updates requirements.txt. CI running.

jing: PR: https://github.com/redwood/analytics-api/pull/789 — pinned, added canary helm values, and extra logging for deserialization paths.

maria: quick verification commands for owners: `python -c "import sqlalchemy; print(sqlalchemy.__version__)"` and run targeted test: `pytest tests/test_query_types.py::TestMutableComposite`

aj: after PRs, run secrets-scan and SBOM regen. if build step uploads artifacts to s3, ensure no creds are in build logs. I'll run `build-scan --full` on both images.

security-oncall: keep me updated during canary. if we observe anything anomalous, cut traffic and escalate. I'll prepare customer-facing note in case of wider impact. :calendar:

maria: thanks — reconvene after canary at +3h. :thumbsup:
